title: Tasks
body: A concrete piece of work under a Feature. An HQDM `activity`. Its `hours` and `doneFlag` feed the feature's rollups.

title: Hours
body: Estimated hours (a `physical_quantity`). Editing this cascades to the feature's `effort`.

title: Done flag
body: 1 when status is done, else 0 (a computed column). The feature rolls this up into `taskDone`.

title: Status
body: The task's lifecycle state (an HQDM `state`); the event log's timestamps give each state change its 4-D temporal extent.

title: Docs
body: A Confluence-style page. An HQDM `sign` (a representation) that documents a Feature; the Docs board is its editorial pipeline by status.

title: Editorial status
body: draft → in review → published: the doc's lifecycle state, grouped as columns on the Docs board.
